lines.say: String methods clean text. strip removes the spaces at both ends, upper makes capitals, and replace swaps one piece of text for another.

c3.heading: String methods: cleaning text
c3.code:
entry = "  amoxicillin 250mg  "
print(entry.strip())
print(entry.strip().upper())
print("250mg".replace("mg", " mg"))
c3.callout: Strings can't be changed in place. drug.upper() gives a new string, so save it: drug = drug.upper().

lwalk.code:
# Clean a messy drug entry
entry = "  amoxicillin 250mg  "
drug = entry.strip().capitalize()
print(drug)
print("Length:", len(drug))
print("Code:", drug[:4].upper())
print(drug.replace("250mg", "250 mg"))
